originalTitle: Trump's diesel dilemma — by the numbers
summary: Conflicts in Ukraine and Iran have created major ripple effects across global energy markets causing major price swings.
content:
Diesel prices are surging as midterms approach – and they are likely to stay high in the near future, according to analysts.

The International Energy Agency's monthly report for October, released Wednesday, was the latest to predict that constraints on the diesel market will likely keep prices elevated into next year. The group warned that even if refineries step up production of diesel into the year-end, inventories will likely remain strained until the second half of 2027.

Last Friday, President Donald Trump unexpectedly paused sanctions on Russian diesel fuel and announced that he reached a deal with President Vladimir Putin in which the Kremlin would release 4.8 million metric tons of diesel , or nearly 36 million barrels, to the global market.

Over the weekend, he took to Truth Social to announce an "energy ceasefire" between Russia and Ukraine , but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy later accused Russia of attacking the country's energy facilities .

The foreign policy developments come as rising fuel prices — particularly skyrocketing diesel — have become a major flashpoint ahead of this year's midterm election. But releasing Russian diesel to the global market is unlikely to drop prices in the near term. A note from Goldman Sachs last week even predicted that diesel prices will remain high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand.

Here's what the numbers tell us so far:

Wholesale diesel prices have more than doubled since the beginning of 2026 through the end of September as both the war in Iran and Russia's war in Ukraine have dramatically cut global supply.

Trump has insisted that the war in Ukraine is to blame for high diesel prices. On July 8, Russia banned diesel exports after Ukraine struck its refineries. In the U.S., the price of a gallon of diesel rose nearly 40% between July 6 and Sept. 22.

However, the price of diesel had already jumped after the Iran war started and was still 20% above its prewar level when Russia instituted its export ban, making that tightening of supply feel that much more acute.

Indeed, both conflicts have created major ripple effects across global energy markets causing major swings, sometimes daily.
chineseTitle: 特朗普的柴油困境——从数字来看
chineseSummary: 乌克兰和伊朗的冲突在全球能源市场产生了重大连锁反应，导致价格大幅波动。
chineseContent:
分析师表示，随着中期选举的临近，柴油价格正在飙升，并且在不久的将来可能会保持在高位。

国际能源署周三发布的十月月度报告最新预测，柴油市场的限制可能会导致明年价格持续上涨。该组织警告称，即使炼油厂在年底前提高柴油产量，库存在 2027 年下半年之前可能仍将紧张。

上周五，唐纳德·特朗普总统出人意料地暂停了对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，并宣布他与弗拉基米尔·普京总统达成协议，克里姆林宫将向全球市场释放 480 万吨柴油，即近 3600 万桶。

周末，他在Truth Social上宣布俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的“能源停火”，但乌克兰总统泽伦斯基随后指责俄罗斯袭击了该国的能源设施。

外交政策的发展正值燃油价格上涨（尤其是柴油价格飙升）成为今年中期选举前的一个主要爆发点。但向全球市场释放俄罗斯柴油不太可能在短期内降低价格。高盛上周的一份报告甚至预测，由于炼油厂难以满足需求，柴油价格将在 2027 年之前保持高位。

到目前为止，这些数字告诉我们的信息如下：

自2026年初到9月底，由于伊朗战争和俄罗斯乌克兰战争大幅削减了全球供应，柴油批发价格上涨了一倍多。

特朗普坚称，柴油价格高企应归咎于乌克兰战争。 7月8日，乌克兰炼油厂遭到袭击后，俄罗斯禁止柴油出口。在美国，7月6日至9月22日期间每加仑柴油的价格上涨了近40%。

然而，伊朗战争爆发后，柴油价格已经大幅上涨，并且在俄罗斯实施出口禁令时仍比战前水平高出 20%，使得供应紧缩的感觉更加严重。

事实上，这两场冲突都在全球能源市场上产生了重大连锁反应，造成重大波动，有时甚至每天都会发生波动。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
